chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There is no breastfeeding (creating kinship) after weaning.' I said, 'May I be your ransom, what is weaning?' He said, 'The two years which Allah, Exalted and Mighty, said.'
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of weaning (fityam) in Shia jurisprudence regarding breastfeeding kinship?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the specific temporal boundary for *radāʿ* (breastfeeding) to establish marital prohibitions, defining weaning (*fiṭām*) as the completion of two full years. By linking this definition directly to the Quranic verse, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides the exegetical basis for the legal consensus in Shia jurisprudence that nursing after this period does not create kinship ties.
